messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — final review of company-level OKRs for Q3/Q4. I incorporated feedback from the leadership sync and customer prioritization session. Need sign-off by EOD Friday so we can lock the roadmap and update comms. Posting the updated draft below.

sam: Thanks. Scanning now — two quick Qs: (1) the latency goal of 25% — baseline is which SLA? (2) the model catalog expansion looks pretty ambitious for a single quarter.

rajesh: For latency: baseline is average p50 token latency across hosted models for January -> current baseline. 25% is aggressive — we can reliably target 15–20% with runtime changes and batching improvements. Hitting 25% would require a dedicated infra sprint + a small kernel optimization effort (~2 weeks).

maria: Good context. Proposal: keep the 25% as a stretch goal and firm the committed target at 20% for Q3; make 25% a Q4 milestone unless engineering can push extra cycles. That frees up ~2 FTE-weeks.

elaine: Budget note: the infra push (if we go full 25% in Q3) roughly adds $120k/quarter on reserved capacity + ops run cost. If we pull to 20% and delay full push to Q4, we can reallocate about $60k from planned marketing experiments.

ken: Legal flag: the Private deployment expansion in OKR 2 includes customer on-prem engagements that require updated contract templates and an addendum for data handling — that adds ~2 weeks from our side. Nothing blocking, just timeline effect.

anne: Ops can support the rollout and take on runbook updates. We’ll need one on-call shadow during the first two weeks of rollout. Easy to staff, wanted to call it out.

okrbuddy: Reminder: sign-off checklist — PM (maria): ✅, Eng (rajesh): pending, Finance (elaine): pending, Legal (ken): pending. Current status: 1/4 signed.

rajesh: I can sign off if we soften the Q3 committed latency target to 20% and keep the 25% as a measurable stretch for Q4. Also want OKR 4 (model catalog) scoped to "curated expansion" not full catalog rollout.

sam: That seems reasonable given strategic priorities. I'm ok moving the catalog expansion to Q4 and setting Q3 committed latency to 20% with a Q4 milestone for 25%. Approving conditionally for exec budget reallocation.

maria: Great — updating the doc now. @elaine can you confirm the $60k reallocation is OK for Q3 so we don't need an extra approval step?

elaine: We can reallocate $60k from the growth experiments budget to cover the Q3 infra work. Anything beyond that requires exec approval (Sam).

sam: I approve the $60k reallocation. Finance, noted. Ken — legal ok with the adjusted timeline?

ken: Legal can produce the addendum. Timeline +2 weeks for review and signature, which is compatible with the Q3 -> Q4 move for full catalog. No other legal blockers.

maria: Awesome. Final step: can folks type 'sign' in thread to formally record sign-off? I’ll export as the canonical approval record.

rajesh: sign

anne: :thumbsup: sign

elaine: sign

ken: sign

sam: sign — thanks team. Maria, please publish and ping comms + sales.

maria: Done — published final OKRs and locked the roadmap. Link: https://docs.redwood.inference/okr/2026-q3-q4-final (internal). I also added a short runbook TODO list. If anyone needs to edit, ping me directly. :sparkles:
